title: Primary KL10 architecture documents
summary: The core architecture set for instruction behavior, effective addressing, paging, memory, APR/PI, and KL10 system organization.
procedure: Start with the 1982 DECsystem-10/DECSYSTEM-20 Processor Reference for instruction and system-visible behavior.
Use the 1984 KL10 Technical Reference for KL10-R hardware, minimum memory, EBOX/MBOX and channel-oriented hardware details.
Use Extended Addressing on the DECSYSTEM-20 for Model-B local/global effective-address and 30-bit PC rules.
invariants: Section zero retains compatibility effective-address behavior.
Model-B nonzero-section execution uses extended addressing rules.
The PC section and word fields do not carry into one another during ordinary sequential increment.
